dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a high-contrast dark perimeter with a sharp gradient transition into a lighter interior. The perimeters are characterized by non-uniform widths and occasional serrated edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of discrete, high-intensity white pixel clusters distributed primarily along the lateral margin. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as concentrated, asymmetrical blobs against the darker dorsal background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle. A series of smaller high-intensity blobs form a loose curvilinear arrangement following the lower lateral contour.
